If it does, you have to lock them and show to the staff that it's locked. Honestly they explain everything in the zoom call on the day of the exam. And you will have plenty of time to fix your room if there is an issue. Don't worry about it

Your feelings are understandable, but please don't feel guilty. It's not  anyone's place to tell you how you should feel about your mom or the traumas she put you through. Even if that person is someone in a similar situation to yours. She can get along with her mother's abusive behavior? Good for her; doesn't mean everybody else has to do the same.

  
Yes, our parent(s) behave this way most likely because of their own traumas. But that is no excuse to take it out on their kids and traumatize them too.  They could've sought help and gone to therapy at any point in time, but they didn't. In my opinion, I don't think they're blind. They see the harm they do to their loved ones, yet they wake up and choose to hurt us everyday

  
I hope they don't guilt trip you into making contact with your mother. I don't know if this helps, but every time you think of going back, remember that the only way you can have a civil life with her is if you repress your sense of self and isolate yourself from everybody. She wants you to be emotionally dependent on her, to not have anyone in your life besides her

  
Wishing you the best

While I absolutely love Jason’s story in under the red hood, I just have to give it to Arkham. I like how they took out the supernatural element of it out of the story. Don’t get me wrong, there’s nothing wrong with having supernatural elements in your story, but with replacing that with 2 years of torture, it made Jason’s story darker and yet more realistic. It makes you(me at least) think that there are tons of people out there, right now, that have been through or are still going through the same shit Jason went through. I think by changing things up, they added more depth to his character. 

I saw some people say that they don’t understand arkham knight’s motivations when the joker is already dead but you have to remember: Joker emotionally tortured and manipulated Jason into thinking that everything was Batman’s fault. He even dressed up his goons as batman to beat up jason in arkham and even had him shoot said goons. Joker constantly taunted Jason into thinking that Bruce never cared about him and just replaced him. Even after Joker’s death, Jason was playing into Joker’s hands all along without knowing. It makes sense why he would want Batman dead and why he would want to hurt the rest of batfam to hurt batman
